newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline falls hard, more than U.S. futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline falls hard, more than U.S. futures.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices fell sharply on Monday and the losses appeared to outpace those on NYMEX futures screens, traders said.

Eurograde barges traded at widely differing levels. A deal was concluded in the morning at $216 fob ARA, while the offer was at $213. Another was heard done at $208 later, and brokers said that by the end of the day the offer was at that level.
U.K. interest was seen for a very small, very prompt Eurograde piece "in the low 220s" cif NWE, dealers said. U.S. numbers were almost attractive, but no business was heard done.
